title: Route protection: auto-trigger policy for degradation and circuit-breakers
creator: Maya Chen
description: Problem statement: We need a deterministic, observable policy to automatically degrade traffic and trip circuit-breakers when downstream capacity is constrained or error signals spike. Current routing fallbacks are manual or tuned ad-hoc per-incident; this work specifies autopilot triggers and safe guardrails for region selection, tier-based routing, and model-variant fallbacks (quantized/cheap variants). Goals: 1) reduce customer-facing 429s/timeouts by proactively routing or degrading; 2) avoid cascading failures by tripping circuit-breakers at the right granularity (route, tier, region); 3) provide clear telemetry and audit trail for every automatic decision; 4) support configurable thresholds per-customer and global defaults.
acceptance_criteria: Implement trigger evaluation service that computes aggregated signals (429-rate, timeout-rate, error-rate) with a 1m and 5m sliding window per route/tier/region.
Default policy: if 429s >= 2% pct of requests AND p95 latency increase > 2x over baseline on 1m window => start graceful degradation sequence.
Circuit-breaker state machine with CLOSED, OPEN, HALFWAY (probe), and COOL_DOWN states implemented and recorded in trace/span for every decision.
Automatic fallback to compatible model variant (e.g., quantized or smaller sequence-length optimized model) with telemetry that ties degradation decisions to model-variant selection.
Config API to override thresholds at customer, route, and region scope and a UI surface in Console to view and edit active auto-trigger policies.
End-to-end integration tests and chaos scenarios demonstrating prevention of cascading errors in a multi-region testbed.
Documentation and runbook added (links below) and two SRE-led war games confirming behaviour against synthetic load patterns.
implementation_plan: Design signal aggregation: implement lightweight streaming counter backed by Redis TS or in-memory ring buffers for 1m/5m windows.
Policy engine: new microservice (route-protector) that evaluates rules and emits actions (DEGRADE_ROUTE, TRIP_CIRCUIT, PROBE).
Action executor: extend smart-router to accept route-protector actions with safe ordering and idempotency keys.
Model-variant compatibility table: add metadata to model catalog to indicate fallback-safe variants and required input shape changes.
Persist decisions to events stream (kafka) for audit and replay; ensure every automated decision includes reason, signal snapshot, and responsible policy id.
Console changes: view current CB state per route, recent triggers, and allow manual override/ack. Backend API for overrides.
Security: ensure cross-tenant isolation for per-customer overrides; only org-admins can change customer-scoped thresholds.
testing_plan: Unit tests for state transitions (CLOSED->OPEN->HALFWAY->CLOSED) including race conditions and duplicate triggers.
Integration tests: simulate 429 storms from a region and assert route-protector triggers model variant fallback and rate-limits are applied within 30s.
Load testing: run canary with synthetic traffic up to 200% of typical peak to validate hysteresis and cooldown prevent flip-flopping.
Chaos experiments: induce timeouts in a single model shard and assert circuit-breaker prevents cross-shard degradation.
Observability verification: dashboards show trigger latency, action latencies, and counts; alerts fire if auto-trigger rate > threshold.
rollout_plan: Phase 0 (internal): deploy route-protector to staging, enable for internal org only with verbose logging.
Phase 1 (canary): enable for 5% of production routes (low-traffic routes), run dark trials where decisions are logged but not enforced for 24h.
Phase 2 (enforce): enable enforcement for canary cohort, monitor for 48h, adjust thresholds based on observed false positives.
Phase 3 (gradual ramp): expand to 25% -> 50% -> 100% of routes over 2 weeks with automated rollback on high false-positive rate.
Emergency rollback: feature-flag to globally disable auto-trigger decisions and immediate manual circuit reset via Console.
